title: Take a number apart
description:
Read a three-digit whole number and print its digits on separate lines, hundreds first.

For `472` print:

```
4
7
2
```

Use only `/` and `%`.
hints: `n % 10` is always the last digit. `n / 10` chops the last digit off.
Hundreds: `n / 100`. Tens: chop the last digit, then take the last digit of what remains: `n / 10 % 10`. Ones: `n % 10`.
